Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the New York Times source, conflating the article’s publication date (Nov. 13, 1977) with the actual election date. The article explicitly states “NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 12 — Ernest N. Morial was elected…,” indicating the election was on Nov. 12, 1977. This misinterpretation led the Planner to assert and seek confirmation for the incorrect election date.
